cases.name: Ciara Dawn Rivera Sloan
cases.about: Her obituary said Ciera went to school and was raised in Hammon. She married Tyler Sloan in 2015. She was baptized in Christ recently. Loved basketball, drawing, being crazy with her friends, and loved being a mother to her children.
